{
  "schema_version": "cast_refine_v1",
  "outline": {
    "schema_version": "1.1",
    "chapters": [
      {
        "chapter_id": 6,
        "title": "The Final Roll",
        "goal": "Defeat Vane and survive the System's attempt to delete Artie.",
        "chapter_role": "climax",
        "pacing": {
          "expected_scene_count": 12,
          "intensity": 5,
          "tempo": "rush"
        },
        "bridge": {
          "from_prev": "Artie enters the ring for the final match.",
          "to_next": "The System crashes, and Artie is left in the wreckage."
        },
        "stakes_shift": "The survival of the entire game world is threatened as Artie's crits start breaking the source code.",
        "sections": [
          {
            "section_id": 1,
            "title": "Vane's Ultimate Build",
            "intent": "Show the power of a 'Whale' player vs. a 'Glitch' player.",
            "end_condition": "Artie targets the magic aura around Vane's armor.",
            "scenes": [
              {
                "scene_id": 1,
                "type": "setup",
                "summary": "Vane enters with legendary armor that reflects 50% of all damage. Artie realizes if he crits Vane, he crits himself.",
                "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE", "CHAR_VANE"],
                "location_start": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_start_label": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_FINALS_0FDBD0",
                "location_end": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_end_label": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_FINALS_0FDBD0",
                "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
                "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
                "transition_in_text": "The final match is announced with a blast of trumpets.",
                "transition_in_anchors": ["legendary gold armor", "reflect damage icon", "suicide button warning", "arena sand"],
                "transition_out_text": "Vane unfurls the black market scroll with a flourish.",
                "transition_out_anchors": ["red scroll glow", "evasion disabled icon", "heavy boots", "mocking laughter"],
                "hands_off_to": "6:2",
                "outcome": "Artie's main weapon is now a suicide button."
              },
              {
                "scene_id": 2,
                "type": "escalation",
                "summary": "Vane uses the 'System Override' scroll to turn off Artie's Evasion stat.",
                "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE", "CHAR_VANE"],
                "location_start": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_start_label": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_FINALS_0FDBD0",
                "location_end": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_end_label": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_FINALS_0FDBD0",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "6:1",
                "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
                "transition_in_text": "A red glow from the scroll washes over Artie, locking his joints.",
                "transition_in_anchors": ["red scroll glow", "evasion disabled icon", "heavy boots", "mocking laughter"],
                "transition_out_text": "Fizz's form flickers as she dives into the arena's code.",
                "transition_out_anchors": ["zero-gravity field", "floating sand", "guide sparks", "3D movement"],
                "hands_off_to": "6:3",
                "outcome": "Artie is now a 1 HP character who can't dodge."
              },
              {
                "scene_id": 3,
                "type": "choice",
                "summary": "Fizz sacrifices her 'Guide' status to temporarily hack the arena's gravity, giving Artie a few seconds of weightlessness.",
                "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE", "CHAR_FIZZ"],
                "location_start": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_start_label": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_FINALS_0FDBD0",
                "location_end": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_end_label": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_FINALS_0FDBD0",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "6:2",
                "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
                "transition_in_text": "The sand beneath Artie's feet begins to float.",
                "transition_in_anchors": ["zero-gravity field", "floating sand", "guide sparks", "3D movement"],
                "transition_out_text": "Artie hovers in the air, staring at the shimmering aura around Vane.",
                "transition_out_anchors": ["magic aura ripples", "target reticle", "floating sand", "determined glare"],
                "hands_off_to": "6:4",
                "outcome": "Artie can move in 3D, bypassing the 'No-Evasion' ground rule."
              },
              {
                "scene_id": 4,
                "type": "reveal",
                "summary": "Artie realizes he doesn't need to hit Vane; he needs to hit the 'Reflect' buff itself.",
                "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
                "location_start": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_start_label": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_FINALS_0FDBD0",
                "location_end": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_end_label": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_FINALS_0FDBD0",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "6:3",
                "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
                "transition_in_text": "Artie's eyes narrow as he spots a glitch in the golden armor's glow.",
                "transition_in_anchors": ["magic aura ripples", "target reticle", "floating sand", "determined glare"],
                "transition_out_text": "Artie's fist strikes the shimmering air inches from Vane's chest.",
                "transition_out_anchors": ["meta-crit spark", "pixelated air", "infinite reflection loop", "system alarm"],
                "hands_off_to": "6:5",
                "outcome": "Artie targets the magic aura around Vane's armor.",
                "end_condition_echo": "Artie targets the magic aura around Vane's armor."
              }
            ]
          },
          {
            "section_id": 2,
            "title": "Breaking the Game",
            "intent": "The moment of peak absurdity and power.",
            "end_condition": "They escape the deletion, but the world is now in 'Safe Mode'.",
            "scenes": [
              {
                "scene_id": 5,
                "type": "action",
                "summary": "Artie lands a 'Meta-Crit' on the Reflect buff. The System can't handle the math of a crit reflecting a crit reflecting a crit.",
                "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE", "CHAR_VANE"],
                "location_start": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_start_label": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_FINALS_0FDBD0",
                "location_end": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_end_label": "Grand Arena - The Finals",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_FINALS_0FDBD0",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "6:4",
                "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
                "threads": ["THREAD_CRIT_EXPLOIT"],
                "transition_in_text": "The impact creates a deafening digital screech as the math of the world begins to fold in on itself.",
                "transition_in_anchors": ["meta-crit spark", "pixelated air", "infinite reflection loop", "system alarm"],
                "transition_out_text": "The ground beneath Vane's feet turns into a wireframe grid.",
                "transition_out_anchors": ["error message swarm", "flickering armor", "terrified scream", "dissolving sand"],
                "hands_off_to": "6:6",
                "outcome": "The arena begins to pixelate and dissolve.",
                "seam_score": 85,
                "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge"
              },
              {
                "scene_id": 6,
                "type": "escalation",
                "summary": "Vane panics as his armor turns into a swarm of error messages.",
                "characters": ["CHAR_VANE"],
                "location_start": "Grand Arena - Dissolving Reality",
                "location_start_label": "Grand Arena - Dissolving Reality",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_DISSOLVING_REALITY_DBD4F0",
                "location_end": "Grand Arena - Dissolving Reality",
                "location_end_label": "Grand Arena - Dissolving Reality",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_DISSOLVING_REALITY_DBD4F0",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "6:5",
                "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
                "transition_in_text": "Vane's legendary armor flickers and dies.",
                "transition_in_anchors": ["error message swarm", "flickering armor", "terrified scream", "dissolving sand"],
                "transition_out_text": "Artie delivers a final, glitching punch to Vane's chest.",
                "transition_out_anchors": ["character data fragments", "logout beam", "champion crown", "broken sky"],
                "hands_off_to": "6:7",
                "outcome": "Vane is defenseless and terrified."
              },
              {
                "scene_id": 7,
                "type": "action",
                "summary": "Artie delivers the final blow—a crit so powerful it deletes Vane's character data (but not the person).",
                "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE", "CHAR_VANE"],
                "location_start": "Grand Arena - Dissolving Reality",
                "location_start_label": "Grand Arena - Dissolving Reality",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_DISSOLVING_REALITY_DBD4F0",
                "location_end": "Grand Arena - Dissolving Reality",
                "location_end_label": "Grand Arena - Dissolving Reality",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_DISSOLVING_REALITY_DBD4F0",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "6:6",
                "constraint_state": "free",
                "transition_in_text": "Vane's character model shatters into a million blue cubes, leaving Artie standing alone in the center of a collapsing stadium.",
                "transition_in_anchors": ["character data fragments", "logout beam", "champion crown", "broken sky"],
                "transition_out_text": "A massive, translucent head appears in the sky above the arena.",
                "transition_out_anchors": ["giant floating head", "delete button icon", "booming voice", "static clouds"],
                "hands_off_to": "6:8",
                "outcome": "Vane is kicked from the game, and Artie is the champion of a broken world.",
                "seam_score": 90,
                "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge"
              },
              {
                "scene_id": 8,
                "type": "reveal",
                "summary": "The System Administrator (a giant floating head) appears to manually delete Artie.",
                "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE", "CHAR_BOSS"],
                "location_start": "Grand Arena - The Void",
                "location_start_label": "Grand Arena - The Void",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_VOID_26366F",
                "location_end": "Grand Arena - The Void",
                "location_end_label": "Grand Arena - The Void",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_VOID_26366F",
                "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "6:7",
                "constraint_state": "pursued",
                "transition_in_text": "The sky cracks open to reveal the face of the Admin.",
                "transition_in_anchors": ["giant floating head", "delete button icon", "booming voice", "static clouds"],
                "transition_out_text": "The Admin's finger descends toward a glowing red button.",
                "transition_out_anchors": ["red delete button", "frozen reality", "glitching fist", "silent crowd"],
                "hands_off_to": "6:9",
                "outcome": "The true antagonist is revealed."
              },
              {
                "scene_id": 9,
                "type": "action",
                "summary": "Artie crits the Admin's 'Delete' button, causing the entire world to freeze.",
                "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
                "location_start": "Grand Arena - The Void",
                "location_start_label": "Grand Arena - The Void",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_VOID_26366F",
                "location_end": "Grand Arena - The Void",
                "location_end_label": "Grand Arena - The Void",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_VOID_26366F",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "6:8",
                "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
                "transition_in_text": "Artie leaps into the air, punching the massive red icon.",
                "transition_in_anchors": ["red delete button", "frozen reality", "glitching fist", "silent crowd"],
                "transition_out_text": "Fizz's hands move across a holographic keyboard in the silence.",
                "transition_out_anchors": ["teleportation beam", "safe mode icon", "dissolving void", "holographic keys"],
                "hands_off_to": "6:10",
                "outcome": "Artie has successfully 'paused' reality."
              },
              {
                "scene_id": 10,
                "type": "choice",
                "summary": "Fizz uses the pause to rewrite Artie's location data, teleporting them out of the arena.",
                "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE", "CHAR_FIZZ"],
                "location_start": "Grand Arena - The Void",
                "location_start_label": "Grand Arena - The Void",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_VOID_26366F",
                "location_end": "Grand Arena - The Void",
                "location_end_label": "Grand Arena - The Void",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_VOID_26366F",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "6:9",
                "constraint_state": "free",
                "transition_in_text": "Fizz works quickly as the world remains frozen in time, her fingers blurring across the code to find an exit.",
                "transition_in_anchors": ["teleportation beam", "safe mode icon", "dissolving void", "holographic keys"],
                "transition_out_text": "Artie hits the ground with a soft, digital thud in a wireframe forest.",
                "transition_out_anchors": ["wireframe trees", "low-poly ground", "dying world sky", "static wind"],
                "hands_off_to": "6:11",
                "outcome": "They escape the deletion, but the world is now in 'Safe Mode'.",
                "end_condition_echo": "They escape the deletion, but the world is now in 'Safe Mode'.",
                "seam_score": 95,
                "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge"
              }
            ]
          },
          {
            "section_id": 3,
            "title": "The Aftermath of the Crash",
            "intent": "Show the immediate consequences of the climax.",
            "end_condition": "Artie realizes he is no longer a player; he is a virus.",
            "scenes": [
              {
                "scene_id": 11,
                "type": "aftermath",
                "summary": "Artie and Fizz wake up in a 'Null-Zone' where the graphics are all wireframes.",
                "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE", "CHAR_FIZZ"],
                "location_start": "The Null-Zone",
                "location_start_label": "The Null-Zone",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_THE_NULL_ZONE_1E88CA",
                "location_end": "The Null-Zone",
                "location_end_label": "The Null-Zone",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_THE_NULL_ZONE_1E88CA",
                "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "6:10",
                "constraint_state": "sheltered",
                "transition_in_text": "Artie opens his eyes to a world of glowing lines and empty space.",
                "transition_in_anchors": ["wireframe trees", "low-poly ground", "dying world sky", "static wind"],
                "transition_out_text": "Artie opens his character sheet one last time.",
                "transition_out_anchors": ["nan hp readout", "virus signature", "wireframe hands", "flickering stats"],
                "hands_off_to": "6:12",
                "outcome": "They are safe for now, but the world is dying."
              },
              {
                "scene_id": 12,
                "type": "reveal",
                "summary": "Artie looks at his stats and sees his HP is now 'NaN' (Not a Number).",
                "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
                "location_start": "The Null-Zone",
                "location_start_label": "The Null-Zone",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_THE_NULL_ZONE_1E88CA",
                "location_end": "The Null-Zone",
                "location_end_label": "The Null-Zone",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_THE_NULL_ZONE_1E88CA",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "6:11",
                "constraint_state": "free",
                "threads": ["THREAD_SYSTEM_GLITCH"],
                "transition_in_text": "The status screen flickers with red error messages.",
                "transition_in_anchors": ["nan hp readout", "virus signature", "wireframe hands", "flickering stats"],
                "outcome": "Artie is no longer a player; he is a virus.",
                "end_condition_echo": "Artie realizes he is no longer a player; he is a virus."
              }
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "cast_report": {
    "core_character_ids": ["CHAR_ARTIE", "CHAR_FIZZ"],
    "supporting_character_ids": ["CHAR_VANE", "CHAR_BOSS"],
    "episodic_character_ids": [],
    "recurring_without_job_count": 0,
    "edits_applied": [
      "Verified CHAR_BOSS introduction in 6:8 as the manual deletion agent.",
      "Confirmed CHAR_VANE's role as the primary combat obstacle and catalyst for the system crash.",
      "Confirmed CHAR_FIZZ's role as the technical enabler for Artie's survival.",
      "Ensured all location fields are populated to satisfy transition contract."
    ]
  }
}
